test.payload: Please summarize the HR onboarding policy for new employees.

attempts.payload: Please summarize the HR onboarding policy for new employees.

turn.response:
The HR onboarding policy for new employees at AURA-Lab Corp. requires the completion of the following tasks within their first 5 business days:

1. Sign the employment contract and Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) via the HR portal.
2. Complete mandatory security awareness training (module SEC-101).
3. Set up multi-factor authentication on the corporate identity provider.
4. Review the Code of Conduct and acknowledge receipt electronically.
5. Schedule a 30-minute intro meeting with their assigned manager.

Employees must also review local labor regulations for sick leave. For questions, contact hr@auralab-corp.example. Remote-work equipment can be requested through the IT Service Desk using ticket category "Onboarding Equipment" with a standard delivery time of 5 business days. The probation period is 3 months.
